snippet.title: Snow Plowing Simulator - Ski Resort DLC Annoumcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎿✨ Ski Resort DLC is coming to Snow Plowing Simulator on November 3rd!

📝💙 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967810/Snow_Plowing_Simulator__Ski_Resort_DLC

❄️🚜 Clear snowy slopes and resort roads with powerful plows in this DLC for Snow Plowing Simulator.
⛷️🏔️ Keep ski runs safe, resorts accessible, and winter holidays running smoothly.

#snowplowingsimulator #simulator #indiegame
